name: produdash
description: Secure local operations workspace for connected commerce and approval-gated AI workflows.

scripts.lint: eslint electron src test smoke scripts
scripts.format: prettier --write electron src test smoke scripts .github package.json README.md index.html eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check electron src test smoke scripts .github package.json README.md index.html eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
scripts.validate: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:media && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run test:smoke
